title: Validation of participants at onboarding and during the lifecycle

statement.en: The governance authority shall define validation criteria for each type of participant claim, including the onboarding of a participant into a role, shall record for each check how it was performed and by whom, and shall re-validate participants during their lifecycle at the interval set at Level 1. Execution of the checks may be delegated to a trusted third party named in the rulebook.

control: The onboarding record is complete for each admitted participant and is reviewed at admission and at each re-validation
trustFramework: The data space trust framework defines the claim types and accepted trust anchors (EN 18235-2 annex A.3.3)

expressions.note: Participant credential carrying the validated claims, where claims are issued and verified as credentials.
